profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker PONY, headquartered in Guangzhou. Its own site describes it as a global autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. The company says it is developing autonomous driving technology and holds licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide.

Pony.ai describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and organizes its work into three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). It states that its autonomous driving vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. The company describes itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving.

The company's site presents its stated aim as bringing what it calls safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility to the entire world, across everyday travel and commercial logistics.
